overview.en:
Research US case law, statutes, regulations, and federal dockets, then draft and cite-check litigation work product with Midpage's official MCP and MIT-licensed skills.

Research U.S. legal materials with explicit jurisdiction and issue scope. Preserve original citations and separate source findings from draft argument.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
研究美国案例、法规与诉讼记录，起草并核对法律文书引用。

在明确司法辖区与问题范围后研究美国法律资料，保留原始引用，并区分来源发现与论证草稿。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Find cases relevant to this legal issue and summarize their holdings.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查找与这个法律问题相关的案例，并总结裁判要点。

starterPrompts.en: Check the citations in this draft against the available source material.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 依据可用来源资料核对这份草稿中的引用。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a research outline comparing these legal authorities.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备研究提纲，比较这些法律依据。

descriptions.en: Cite-checks a brief, motion, or memo (PDF/Word): verifies each cited case is real, supports the proposition, is good law, and quoted accurately. Returns one marked-up .docx with comments and redlines.
Drafts court filings — motions, memoranda of law, appellate briefs — as court-ready .docx, with Midpage research behind every citation. Use to "draft a motion to dismiss," "write the brief."

Writes a formal objective legal research memo (Questions Presented, Brief Answers, Facts, IRAC Discussion, Conclusion) as a .docx. Use to "draft a research memo on whether…" Predicts, never advocates.
Writes public-facing litigation updates — blog posts, client alerts, LinkedIn/X posts — on a federal case or legal development. Use to "write a blog post about…," "draft a client alert on…"
Apply legal-research, citation, privacy, docket, source-verification, and document-generation safeguards whenever using Midpage MCP or its litigation drafting and cite-checking skills.
